author: HBO Max
description:
What does it take to bring the Green Lantern mythos down to Earth? In Lanterns: The Official Podcast, Juju Green sits down with showrunner, executive producer, co-creator and writer Chris Mundy, writer and co-executive producer Vanessa Baden Kelly, and director and executive producer James Hawes to break down Episode 2, “Trust Fall.” 

The creators discuss building the grounded world of Lanterns, separating John Stewart and Hal Jordan, designing their approach to flight, and crafting the episode’s massive car chase. They also reveal how Earl, Hal Jordan’s bizarre alien pet, went from a writers’ room idea to one of the episode’s most memorable characters. 

Plus, the team discusses the 48-hour clock, John and Hal’s evolving trust, bringing the iconic villain Sinestro into the story, finding the right balance between comic book mythology and grounded drama, and the process of bringing Sinestro and the Green Lantern elements to life.
